newsitem.title: CANADA: Amber Energy to set 2 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Amber Energy to set 2 mln shr offering.

text.p: Amber Energy Inc said on Wednesday it intended to file a preliminary prospectus for an offering of approximately two million common shares.

Amber said the issue would be sold on a fully marketed basis through an underwriting syndicate led by FirstEnergy Capital Corp and Nesbitt Burns Inc. Other underwriters include Bunting Warburg Inc, Gordon Capital Corp and Newcrest Capital Inc.
Amber said it intended to use proceeds from the offering to reduce bank debt and fund its exploration and development activities in 1997.
The common shares would not be offered in the United States, it said.
